description: Routing policy: which responses get deterministic-only evaluation and which unresolved cases are sent to the LLM judge. Versioned; every adherence_evals.jsonl record stores the sha256 of this file. Changing it creates a new evaluation version -- cached records are never overwritten.

anaphora.reason: Supplied fixed phrase at line starts -- a literal check an LLM cannot improve.

epistrophe.reason: Supplied fixed phrase at line ends -- a literal check an LLM cannot improve.

alliteration.reason: Letter rule is primary (user decision: sound is relevant but letter is easier to evaluate): >=3 words sharing an initial consonant letter, decided by code. Phonetic evidence is attached when a lexicon exists; judge review is requested when every letter-match survives but the sounds plainly conflict across the response.

rhyme_scheme.reason: Only clearly-confirmed rhyme tails resolve deterministically (pass). Everything else -- no strict rhyme tail (slant may still count), identical end words (genuine vs repetition-for-the-rhyme), OOV, missing lexicon, 'part of the reasoning sentences' -- is unknown -> judge. User decisions recorded in docs/adherence_rubric.md.

meter.reason: Stress patterns in context cannot be settled mechanically. Code attaches syllable-range evidence and may fail lines that provably cannot reach 10 syllables; all other cases go to the judge.

question_context: Not sent to the judge for any of the five devices -- no frozen rule requires question semantics. (Documented in docs/adherence_rubric.md; flip only by editing this file and bumping policy_version.)
